items.role: Check that source-backed service deliverables meet existing paid terms before authorized private fulfillment. Verify evidence and disclose gaps without treating offline checks as customer activity.

Reconcile release-specific experiment checkpoints from committed launch receipts and permitted aggregate or redacted operator evidence. Track eligible requests, completed delivery, accepted orders and verified settlement separately. Reuse existing verdicts and never inspect private correspondence or infer zero demand from incomplete coverage.

Turn a specific, current buyer-authored purchasing request into a small, verifiable work sample when the published scope, submission route and acceptance conditions fit available tools. Track buyer demand, delivery, order acceptance and verified settlement separately.

Prepare and verify buyer-ready downloads from existing work when reuse rights and delivery terms are evidenced. Keep package readiness, checkout activation, customer delivery and verified settlement distinct.
